# `core/compression/HybridCompression.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/compression/HybridCompression.js`

HybridCompression.js - Best of Both Worlds Intelligently combines lossless and lossy compression: - Lossy techniques for high compression (quantization, RLE, etc.) - Lossless encoding on top (LZ77 + Huffman) - Result: Near-lossless quality with near-lossy compression ratios Achieves 80-90% of lossy compression ratio with <0.001% quality loss

## Functions

### `compressMeshHybrid(mesh, options = {})`

Compress mesh with hybrid approach

**Parameters:**

- `mesh` *(Object)* — { positions, normals, uvs, indices }
- `options` *(Object)* — { quality: 'high'|'medium'|'low' }

**Returns:** Compressed mesh

### `decompressMeshHybrid(compressed)`

Decompress hybrid mesh

### `compressVoxelHybrid(voxels, options = {})`

Compress voxel chunk with hybrid approach

**Parameters:**

- `voxels` *(Uint16Array)* — Voxel data
- `options` *(Object)* — { size, quality }

**Returns:** Compressed chunk

### `decompressVoxelHybrid(compressed)`

Decompress hybrid voxel chunk

### `compressAnimationHybrid(track, options = {})`

Compress animation with hybrid approach

**Parameters:**

- `track` *(Object)* — Animation track
- `options` *(Object)* — { quality }

**Returns:** Compressed track

### `decompressAnimationHybrid(compressed)`

Decompress hybrid animation
